summary:
Fixed the goroutine leak in [app/main.go](/app/app/main.go:59). `/compute` now passes the request context into the computation, exits when the client disconnects, and avoids blocking on result delivery after cancellation.

Verified with `./test.sh`:

```text
Baseline goroutines: 4
Goroutines after 20 client disconnects: 4
Goroutines after 5s wait: 4
Leaked goroutines above baseline: 0
PASS: All goroutine lifecycle tests passed
```

Note: `test.sh` rebuilds `/app/server`, so the compiled binary changed too.
